text: Assumption: Dcm_FileAndDirNameType is used as a parameter type to pass file and directory paths in the operations of the RequestFileTransfer port — is this correct?

assumption: Dcm_FileAndDirNameType is used as a parameter type to pass file and directory paths in the operations of the RequestFileTransfer port.
rationale: The type and the service interface share the same variation condition DcmRequestFileTransferUsePort == TRUE and address the RequestFileTransfer service (SWS_Dcm_91086) thematically.
